allowedTransitions: DRAFT -> SUBMITTED by F-CUT-004 submit in the same transaction as F-CUT-005 approval start
SUBMITTED -> INVALIDATED only when a frozen source fact becomes invalid and the linked approval is paused in the same transaction
lifecycles.bodyImmutability: SUBMITTED and INVALIDATED revision body, steps, risk facts, file facts, source snapshot and duties are immutable; INVALIDATED only appends invalidated_by, invalidated_at and invalidation_reason_code
lifecycles.approvalProjectionOwner: F-CUT-005; PENDING/PAUSED_SOURCE_INVALIDATED/APPROVED/REJECTED are approval facts, not plan revision states
lifecycles.legacyProjection: LEGACY_READ_ONLY is derived from origin_code=LEGACY_FORWARD and is not persisted as a new-platform lifecycle state

jsonContracts.source_snapshot: PlanSourceSnapshot from F-CUT-004-api-contract.json; NEW_PLATFORM A/B/C/D all freeze task, assessment, project, device, configuration revision, template sections and the complete CUT-03 failedRiskFacts Owner set; only checklist identity is null for D and D failedRiskFacts is an empty array

standardRootFields.overview: exact StandardOverview or StandardDraftOverview while DRAFT
standardRootFields.riskMitigations: exact RiskMitigation[]; DRAFT may contain a unique Owner-matching subset

content_snapshot.exclusions: steps and supportArrangements are never stored in content_snapshot; cut_step and cut_cutover_support_arrangement are their only business truth

conditionalContracts.NEW_PLATFORM_COMMON: edit_mode_code, grade_code, assessment_id/version, configuration_revision_id/code/no, template_section_snapshot and exact PlanSourceSnapshot are non-null; legacy_* are null
conditionalContracts.NEW_PLATFORM_ABC: checklist_id/version are non-null and source snapshot contains all frozen template sections
conditionalContracts.NEW_PLATFORM_D: checklist_id/version are null; configuration and D-applicable OPERATION/ROLLBACK template sections remain frozen
conditionalContracts.FULL_FILE_UPLOAD: grade is A/B/C/D; file identity/version/reference/fact/scope/hash are non-null, ownership_confirmed=1 and content_snapshot is null
conditionalContracts.ONLINE_TEMPLATE_STANDARD: content_snapshot is exact standard root snapshot, file root columns are null and grade is A/B/C; steps and support arrangements exist only in their authoritative child tables
conditionalContracts.ONLINE_TEMPLATE_SIMPLE_D: content_snapshot is exact simple root snapshot, file root columns are null and grade is D; steps exist only in cut_step
conditionalContracts.DRAFT: current_marker=1; submit, approval and invalidation fields are null
conditionalContracts.SUBMITTED: submitted and approval identity/version are non-null; invalidation fields are null; current_marker=1 until invalidated/replaced
conditionalContracts.INVALIDATED: submitted, approval and invalidation fields are non-null; current_marker is null
conditionalContracts.DERIVED_REVISION: source_plan_revision_id and revision_reason_code are both non-null; initial revision has both null
conditionalContracts.LEGACY_FORWARD: edit mode, grade, assessment, checklist, configuration, template, content, file, lifecycle, approval, derivation and invalidation fields are null; legacy identity/raw status/source version/mapping version and exact legacy source snapshot are non-null; current_marker is null

tables.name: cut_step
tables.authority: only business truth for online plan steps; content_snapshot never duplicates steps
tables.newPlatformRule: exact PlanStep projection; D permits only OPERATION and ROLLBACK
tables.legacyRule: one non-blank legacy text field becomes at most one immutable step with step_no=1 according to legacyMigration.fieldMappings

tables.name: cut_cutover_support_arrangement
tables.authority: only business truth for support duties and current contact projection; content_snapshot never duplicates arrangements
tables.standardPlanRule: exactly one row per role; simple D and full-file upload create no rows
tables.dutyChange: must create a new plan revision

taskStagePhysicalDependency.migrationRule: a future serial Flyway must preflight existing cut_task and cut_task_stage_history values, then replace V146/V149 CHECK constraints; never edit executed migrations or rewrite history

additionalFacts.riskMitigations: source_snapshot freezes the complete Owner failedRiskFacts set; content_snapshot stores the exact RiskMitigation subset already completed by the user. DRAFT may omit not-yet-mitigated facts, but each stored row is complete and Owner-matching; save, draft generation and submit rebuild expected SourceFacts from source_snapshot rather than inferring Owner facts from content omissions or a current inspect
additionalFacts.supportArrangementAudit: PlatformCommandExecution operation audit stores before/after personName, phone and arrivalTime plus actor, reason, correlationId and time; no fourth CUT business table
additionalFacts.downloadAudit: platform operation audit plus generated PLT FileArtifact fact records actor, time and plan revision
additionalFacts.approval: approval instance, nodes, opinions, todo and notification are F-CUT-005 facts and are accessed only through F-CUT-005-approval-owner-contract.json

draftAndReadConsistency.save: one plan version CAS transaction atomically replaces the DRAFT root content_snapshot, exact cut_step rows and exact support arrangement rows; partial root/child writes roll back
draftAndReadConsistency.submit: locks root and all child rows, validates one assembled PlanContentUnion, then freezes root and child business fields in the same transaction as approval start
draftAndReadConsistency.read: PlanView content is assembled from root content_snapshot plus cut_step and cut_cutover_support_arrangement; no read path trusts duplicated child arrays
draftAndReadConsistency.approvedContactChange: cut_plan_revision.version is the sole public version Owner: in one transaction CAS the locked root from request If-Match to If-Match+1, then update only person_name, phone and arrival_time on the locked authoritative support row and increment its internal version, append platform before/after audit, and return the new planVersion; any failure rolls back root, child and audit. No arrangementVersion is accepted from clients; role_code and duty_description remain frozen, content_snapshot remains unchanged, and PlanView overlays the current authoritative contact fields

transactionAndLocks: validate trusted tenant and functional permission before platform idempotency

for FULL_FILE_UPLOAD create, inspect the requested FileArtifactFact before the command and call CutoverPlanFilePort.lockAndRevalidate inside the write transaction; request, inspect and locked facts must match and only the locked Owner fact is persisted
lock CutoverTask and validate exact task version plus P4/PLAN_DRAFTING
lock current submitted assessment; for A/B/C lock current submitted checklist; for D assert checklist identity is null
lock current plan revision and revalidate frozen project, device, configuration, template and PLT file facts
on submit freeze revision, call mandatory F-CUT-005 start and transition task P4 -> P5 in one outer CUT transaction

on source invalidation transition SUBMITTED -> INVALIDATED, call F-CUT-005 pause and move task P5/APPROVING -> P4/PLAN_DRAFTING with P5_SOURCE_INVALIDATED history in one transaction; recovery creates a replacement plan revision and approval rather than restoring old facts

qualificationOrder: source row deleted=0 and tenant/id/task_id are positive
PLT external mapping resolves pms_cut_plan.task_id through the already-qualified pms_cut_task source to exactly one same-tenant cut_task origin LEGACY_FORWARD
trimmed code length 1..64 and name length 1..128
level after trim+uppercase is one of A/B/C/D
status is retained only as raw Integer 0..4 and never interpreted as new lifecycle or approval
at least one of pre_check/procedure/verification/rollback is non-blank
version and creator/create_time/updater/update_time are present and valid

rootMappings.cutover_task_id: resolved target cut_task id from PLT mapping, never legacy task_id directly
rootMappings.revision_no: 1 within the LEGACY_FORWARD task chain; conflict is TARGET_IDENTITY_CONFLICT
rootMappings.audit: original creator/create_time/updater/update_time; no current actor fabrication

fieldMappings.code/name/level/remark: stored in the exact immutable legacy source snapshot returned by PlanView and never used to infer new lifecycle

legacyMigration.legacyApprovalDisposition: migration evidence only; never mapped to F-CUT-005 approval, task stage, plan lifecycle or approved fact

platformBatchProtocol.intake: a controlled release importer appends immutable raw source records to PlatformMigrationEvidenceApi and marks the batch STAGED_READY; normal CUT production beans never read legacy tables
platformBatchProtocol.claim: migration job claims one STAGED_READY batch in an outer transaction and receives RECONCILING batch version
platformBatchProtocol.success: target revision/steps, external mapping or retained classification, issues and completeReconciliation commit atomically after unique-source counts reconcile
platformBatchProtocol.temporaryFailure: Provider or infrastructure failure rolls the entire outer transaction back to STAGED_READY for same-batch retry
platformBatchProtocol.rowFailure: invalid qualification creates a stable migration issue/retained classification; target identity conflict is a stable issue and never overwrites target
platformBatchProtocol.terminal: COMPLETED batch is immutable; issue closure only appends approved resolution evidence and a new target attempt requires a new batch referencing the prior issue

legacyMigration.unqualifiedRows: retain pms_cut_plan and classify through PLT evidence; no delete, dual write, default, parsing of approval text or direct SQL cross-context lookup
